title: Paper Tab Story Inference Card Pack
audience: Families, homeschool groups, tutors, and adult-led writing tables for writers ages 7-11.
sessionLength: 16 printable paper tab story inference cards plus adult guide tools, inference routines, take-home inference slips, and optional adult prompts
safetyNote: No scary harm, no bullying, no romance, no weapons, no branded characters, and no identifying facts.

cover.headline: Paper Tab Story Inference Card Pack
cover.subhead: Sixteen paper tab cards help writers connect invented story clues to what they might suggest, why they fit, and one short inference sentence.

adultGuide.title: Paper Tab Story Inference Adult Guide, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.
setupSteps: Place one paper tab card, blank paper, pencil, and scrap tab at the adult-led fictional offline paper-only table: ____________________.
Name the clue, what it might suggest, why, second clue, inference sentence, and paper tab check blanks before writing: ____________________.
Choose one made-up story moment and keep each clue adult-led, fictional, offline, paper-only, and family-friendly: ____________________.
Let the writer point, dictate, or write short paper phrases while the adult keeps the inference calm: ____________________.
Close by reading the inference sentence and paper tab check from the paper card only: ____________________.
facilitationNotes: Ask for one tiny clue first so the adult-led fictional offline paper-only inference has a clear start: ____________________.
Use might suggest language before asking for why, so the writer can try an idea without pressure: ____________________.
Ask why the clue might suggest the idea, and accept a short family-friendly fictional phrase: ____________________.
Add a second clue only after the first clue and why line feel clear on paper: ____________________.
Finish with the paper tab check as a quiet adult-led paper-only mark for the inference sentence: ____________________.
safetyNotes: Keep all names, places, events, clues, and paper tabs made-up for this adult-led fictional offline paper-only activity: ____________________.
Skip any line that asks for personal facts, exact places, outside facts, or child details: ____________________.
Use the tabs only as pretend paper markers for this family-friendly inference card: ____________________.
Keep the inference sentence about the invented story, not about a person outside the card: ____________________.
Treat the paper tab check as a calm ending to one adult-led fictional offline paper-only session: ____________________.

steps: The adult reads the clue slowly from the paper card: ____________________.

The writer fills this line: My second clue is ____________________.

inferenceRoutines.title: Inference Sentence Routine, adult-led fictional offline paper-only family-friendly: ____________________.

The writer chooses the words that belong in one inference sentence: ____________________.
The adult keeps the sentence fictional, offline, paper-only, and family-friendly: ____________________.
The writer completes this line: My inference sentence is ____________________.

cards.suggestsPrompt: might suggest: What might this clue suggest about which greenhouse path the helper should choose: ____________________.
cards.whyPrompt: why: Explain why the clue might suggest that path inside the invented story: ____________________.
cards.secondCluePrompt: second clue: Add another greenhouse clue that points toward the same inference or makes it more exact: ____________________.
cards.inferenceSentencePrompt: inference sentence: Write one sentence that connects both greenhouse clues to what the helper infers: ____________________.
cards.paperTabCheckPrompt: paper tab check: Mark the paper tab when the inference sentence includes a clue, might suggest, why, and second clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle the clue blanks and write only short phrases today: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this paper card and add one new chapter gate greenhouse clue with an adult later: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Paper Tab Inference Card
cards.inferenceSkill: Make a fictional boardwalk inference with a clue, what it might suggest, why, a second clue, an inference sentence, and a paper tab check: ____________________.
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only inference card for an invented binding day boardwalk story with paper ribbons, carts, and rail marks: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card, a pencil, and two blank paper tabs beside a pretend boardwalk strip: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a boardwalk helper who reads two gentle clues and writes one clear inference sentence: ____________________.
cards.cluePrompt: clue: Write one pretend boardwalk clue, such as a loose ribbon, shifted cart card, or marked rail plank: ____________________.
cards.suggestsPrompt: might suggest: What might this clue suggest about what changed before the helper arrived: ____________________.
cards.whyPrompt: why: Explain why the clue might suggest that change in the invented binding day boardwalk story: ____________________.
cards.secondCluePrompt: second clue: Add a different boardwalk clue that supports the inference without copying the first clue: ____________________.
cards.inferenceSentencePrompt: inference sentence: Write one sentence that states what the helper infers from both clues: ____________________.
cards.paperTabCheckPrompt: paper tab check: Mark the paper tab when the sentence is fictional, paper-only, and supported by a second clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Fill the clue and second clue blanks, then stop before the full sentence if needed: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Keep this paper card and add one new boardwalk clue with an adult later: ____________________.
